core: Bud carries a 3D local orthonormal frame T/N/B
candidate directions are sampled on the sphere around the parent axis
light, free-space occupancy, gravity, obstacle repulsion and parent continuity all participate before a Shoot is born
potential buds and released buds are separate states
branch topology writes back into the occupancy field and changes later decisions
camera orientation never participates in generation

kept: subtree / branch hierarchy as a score concept
notClaimed: teacher BR is a species branch count
teacher wind phase is physical force propagation
teacher branch width is a botanical radius rule

speciesBoundary.rule: A future Species Score chooses which branching voices are applicable. The 3D core does not force KuKo topology onto a species.

r01Relationship.projectionLiftR01: kept as a regression bridge from the exact 2D teacher to a forward node graph
r01Relationship.nativeR02: generation decisions occur directly in 3D and no longer preserve a fixed XY projection

qualityGates: changing the camera cannot change the generated graph
changing light azimuth can change 3D branch distribution
enabling a 3D obstacle can change bud release and branch direction
dormant buds remain observable instead of being silently deleted
the result has non-zero Z span without post-process lifting
turning off new environmental weights approaches the grammar-only baseline
